data.name: Jorim
data.long_meaning: The name Jorim is derived from the Hebrew language, meaning 'God is my light'. It is a Biblical name, found in the Old Testament book of Jeremiah, where it is given as a prophetic name to a son of Shallum. This name reflects the belief in God as the source of illumination and guidance, especially in times of darkness and uncertainty.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents a strong connection to God and a reliance on His light to guide and illuminate one's path in life.

data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Jorim lies in its meaning as 'God is my light'. It reflects the belief that God is a source of guidance, protection, and illumination in the darkest of times. The name can serve as a reminder of the presence and power of God, giving comfort, hope, and strength in the face of adversity. It is a powerful reminder of the promise of God's light and guidance, which can help to illuminate the path and provide direction in life.

historical_references.reference: Jorim, son of Jeshunah, was a prominent Levite during the time of King Hezekiah. He played a crucial role in the restoration of the Temple and the reinstitution of the sacrificial system. (2 Chronicles 29:10)

Jorim is also mentioned as the father of King Josiah of Judah in 2 Chronicles 34:1. Josiah ruled during the late 7th and early 6th century BC and is notable for his religious reforms and efforts to restore the Temple.
